title: Guards read a cd flag as its folder (cd -P dir)
notes: src/main/workflow/test-run-guard.ts:55 and src/main/workflow/worktree-guard.ts:41 take changed.words[0] as cd's folder, so cd -P <dir> && ... is judged at <base>/-P and not at <dir>. A removal or test run in <dir> is then judged in the wrong folder. Fix: take the first word that does not start with '-' (keeping cd -). Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/350 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/349#discussion_r4679074374
